# Highlights

The highlighter writes yellow as ==a plain highlight== and the other colours as marks: <mark class="hl-red">red</mark>, <mark class="hl-orange">orange</mark>, <mark class="hl-green">green</mark>, <mark class="hl-teal">teal</mark>, <mark class="hl-blue">blue</mark>, <mark class="hl-purple">purple</mark> and <mark class="hl-grey">grey</mark>.

- A list item with <mark class="hl-green">**bold** inside a highlight</mark>.
